Iconic Super Groundcar. Upgrades: TUp (+1 SP) Armored Chassis (w/ Stalwart Shell), TUp (Enhanced) Autopilot Terminal, Bulletproof Glass [x2], Bulwark Armor, TUp (Reduced visual footprint) Combat Plow, TUp (Self-Driving Vehicle) Communications Center, CrystalDome, NOS [x4], TUp (Uses Autofire [Machine Gun 5]) Onboard Machine Gun (w/ Autoloader) [x2], Reinforced Tires, Sealed Environment, TUp (Hardwired Locks) Security Upgrade (Advanced), Smuggling Upgrade, Stealth Plating. Also: Climate Control. Climate control. Ablation to its SP is 1 less (min 0). Drives itself at Skill Base 16 (basic directions, no Maneuvers except an Emergency Stop). Stealth plating: invisible to scanners and radar, −2 to spot in the dark. A DrinkMaster 3000 built in. Anyone from Arasaka who knows who should be driving it will probably open fire first.

Cost: Super Luxury • Be Saburo’s son. (Cannot be fabricated. Must be gifted or scavenged)
